articles.title: Anti-Muslim US Congressman Andy Ogles loses Republican primary - Al Jazeera
articles.description: Trump’s endorsement fails to save Tennessee legislator who recently said ‘Muslims don’t belong in American society’.
articles.content:
United States Congressman Andy Ogles, who has a history of anti-Muslim statements, has lost his Republican primary in the state of Tennessee despite the endorsement of President Donald Trump.
